{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_clean = completed[completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue_completed = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Confirm the count of internal test orders in the cleaned column
internal_test_count = len(completed[completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99])

# Print the updated evidence
print(f"Number of internal test orders (in cleaned column): {internal_test_count}")
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue_completed}")"}
